propositions: Duplicate CAS push retry loops in workflows were consolidated into a single owner module (src/rebar/_store/push.py) with strict and best-effort delivery modes.
The strict push entrypoint raises PushDeliveryError with typed failure reasons after exhausting a five-cycle retry budget, while best-effort callers retain existing behavior.
A locked commit-and-push transaction entrypoint orchestrates staging, committing, and delivery with stable bot identity and commit subject for automation workflows.

Workflow adapters delegate delivery once through a Python adapter (python -m rebar._store.push) that translates core failures to process exit codes, eliminating workflow-local fetch/merge/retry logic.
Python library, CLI, MCP, and importer callers preserve backward compatibility by defaulting to best-effort delivery; strict mode is opt-in via keyword-only flag.
No persisted schema or ticket vocabulary changed; rollback requires only restoring prior workflow blocks before reverting the strict entrypoints.
